headline: This cannot be done as you asked, so no workflow is offered for it.
points: "Use SAMBAR on our 9 mesothelioma samples and try between 2 and 12 subtypes" -- not available here as asked. "we have somatic mutation counts per gene, exon lengths, a cancer gene list and a GMT pathway file" -- I couldn't match this to anything a registered NetZoo workflow produces or lets you set.
